hypothesis: Inside-day completion pays on the SHORT side: hunt17 showed d1_inside LONG negative everywhere while SHORT had the least-bad cells (NZDCAD SHORT +0.020R, +0.136/+0.169 WF folds). Quiet compression days precede downside continuation more reliably. Lower rr 1.5 (take profits earlier, less 2R friction) and ttl 24.

Breakdowns beat breakouts on D1 swings: hunt17 d1_swing_break SHORT had systematically less-negative exp than LONG across symbols (USDJPY SHORT -0.451 vs LONG -0.010; AUDCAD SHORT -0.393 vs LONG -0.398). Stronger expansion filter (exp_mult 1.2) + rr 2.5 + ttl 24 to isolate the breakout-quality mechanism.

Long-horizon momentum persistence with wider targets: hunt17 h4_momentum LONG n=55/rr2.5 was the least-negative parameterization family-wide; longer MA horizon filters whipsaw, rr 2.5 + ttl 24 captures the persistence leg that 2R/12-bar exits cut off.

Real-yield regime gates gold momentum: 2y rolling z of T10YIE (macrod desk anchors) filters H4 SMA cross entries - LONG only when breakevens are at/below average (falling real yield = gold bid), SHORT above. Mechanism: real-yield is the dominant gold driver; momentum with the regime survives the 2018-2026 rate cycle. Baseline: h4_momentum n34. yield_z=0.0, rr2.0 ttl12.

Mirror of h18-004 on the SHORT side: gold momentum SHORT only when real-yield z >= +0.25 (rising breakevens = gold headwind). Wider n55 + rr2.5 to catch persistence legs in the higher-yield regime. yield_z=-0.25.
Tighter regime filter isolation: yield_z=-0.5 forces entries only in clearly-low real-yield states - tests whether the regime filter carries the edge rather than the momentum base. n34 rr2.0 ttl12.

Dollar-regime-gated gold momentum: gold and DXY are strongly inverse; momentum taken with the dollar regime. DXY 2y rolling z <= -0.5 (weak dollar) for LONG, >= +0.5 for SHORT. Anchors-desk data, fail-closed when missing.
Same mechanism with stronger dollar gate (|z|>=0.75), slower trend filter n=55, wider target rr=2.5, longer hold ttl=24 — fewer but higher-conviction regime trades.
Asia-session (00-08 UTC) mean reversion: H4 close at >=2 ATR from the 20-H4 SMA in the thin Asian session fades; over-extensions revert when London/NY liquidity returns. Fade both sides.
London-NY overlap (13-17 UTC) breakout of the prior 5 sessions overlap high/low: concentrated liquidity makes range breaks persist into the NY close. Price-only, runs on every symbol.
